title: Full-stack .NET software engineer
description: Developer on the Franciscan Friars' internal ERP and public website. Since September 2026, also leading the email platform replacement and moving into product owner for the new public site.
icons: C#, Blazor, ASP.NET, Syncfusion, SQL, Azure
bulletpoints: Led the evaluation to replace the email marketing platform. The two finalists are projected to cut annual platform cost by about $100k, net of year-one costs.
Narrowed 10 email vendors to 2 finalists. Gathered requirements from Communications and the Salesforce admin, ran sales demos, and scored each vendor on 10 weighted requirements.
Found and fixed Meta server-side conversion tracking that had been failing silently for about 18 months. Server events now carry the click ID, and observed coverage went from none to about 90%.
Made five embedded third-party forms visible to GA4. Each form now sends its own event, checked end to end in production with no personal data reaching GA4.
Product owner for the new public website (in progress, launch planned after Thanksgiving 2026). Work with stakeholders to gather requirements.
Built the ERP-to-Salesforce integration that syncs and reconciles records, working alone.
Replaced separate per-department list-view grids with one shared data grid used across 50+ tables.
Built 10 features, including a staff directory with cascading filters and a two-mode prayer wall.
